# `knowledge` operations

The exact fields each `knowledge.*` operation takes and returns.

<!-- Generated by `python scripts/codegen/docs_reference.py` from the op registry; edit the models, not this page. -->

Every op is `POST /v1/<op>` over HTTP and the MCP tool `loom_<op>`. The identity fields (`org`, `namespace`, `agent`, `user_id`, `session_id`) are filled from the token and the MCP session when a transport can; see [identities and namespaces](../../concepts/identities-and-namespaces.md). The [operations index](../operations.md) explains role, kind and the MCP `all` listing. Unknown input fields are served and named in `ignored_args`.

<!-- prettier-ignore-start -->

## `knowledge.add`

WHAT: Ingest a document into the knowledge base for later retrieval via loom_search.

`POST /v1/knowledge.add` · MCP `loom_knowledge_add` · role `writer` · idempotent

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The document's stable identifier in the namespace; `get`, `upsert` and `delete` name it. |
| `content` | `str` | required | The document's extracted text; it is split into chunks, and each chunk is embedded. |
| `title` | `str` | `''` | Document title, stored on the document and in each chunk's context, which heads the chunk's embedded text and is scored by the lexical leg. |
| `description` | `str` | `''` | Stored (with the title) in each chunk's context, so both search legs carry doc-level context. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Labels stored on the document and on every chunk; search and list filter on them. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any]` | *(computed)* | Free-form JSON stored with the document and on every chunk; `knowledge.get` returns it. |
| `original_bytes_b64` | `str \| None` | `None` | Original file bytes (base64), preserved alongside extracted text so users can download exactly what they uploaded. |
| `original_filename` | `str` | `''` | Name of the uploaded file; empty keeps the prior document's name when its blob carries over. |
| `blob_content_type` | `str` | `''` | Media type of `original_bytes_b64`; empty keeps the prior blob's type when it carries over. |
| `agent` | `str` | `''` | The agent writing the document, stored on it and on every chunk for provenance; an end-user token's signed `agent` takes its place. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `''` | The session the document was written in (a chat, an agent run): stored on it and on every chunk, and `knowledge.search` filters on it. |
| `source_class` | `str \| None` | `None` | What the content is, when it is not the writer's own: `derived` (an agent wrote it from other content), `external` (fetched: a page, a tool's result) or `imported`. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `doc_id` | `str` | Id of the document version this call wrote (a fresh UUID per write). |
| `chunks_created` | `int` | How many chunks the content was split into and embedded. |
| `embedding_model` | `str` | Embedding model that produced the chunk vectors. |
| `embedding_dim` | `int` | Dimension of the chunk vectors. |
| `namespace` | `str` | Echo the JWT-bound namespace so agents cite it instead of guessing. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | Echo of the input `source_uri`. |

## `knowledge.bulk_add`

Batched ingestion: many documents in one CH round-trip.

`POST /v1/knowledge.bulk_add` · MCP `loom_knowledge_bulk_add` · role `writer` · idempotent

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `entries` | `list[_KnowledgeBulkEntry]` | required | The documents to add (1-500), each chunked and embedded like a `knowledge.add`; each `source_uri` at most once, or the call is refused (422) with nothing written. |
| `agent` | `str` | `''` | The agent writing the documents, stored on each and on every chunk for provenance; an end-user token's signed `agent` takes its place. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `''` | The session the documents were written in (a chat, an agent run): stored on each and on every chunk, and `knowledge.search` filters on it. |
| `source_class` | `str \| None` | `None` | What the content is, when it is not the writer's own: `derived` (an agent wrote it from other content), `external` (fetched: a page, a tool's result) or `imported`. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `written` | `list[_KnowledgeBulkEntryResult]` | One result per entry, in input order: its `source_uri`, new `doc_id` and chunk count. |
| `embedding_model` | `str` | Embedding model that produced the chunk vectors. |
| `embedding_dim` | `int` | Dimension of the chunk vectors. |

## `knowledge.bulk_delete`

Soft-delete multiple documents by source_uri, in one commit.

`POST /v1/knowledge.bulk_delete` · MCP `loom_knowledge_bulk_delete` · role `writer` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uris` | `list[str]` | required | The documents to soft-delete (1-500). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deleted` | `list[_KnowledgeBulkDeleteResult]` | One result per input URI, in input order, with its tombstoned chunk count (0 if none). |
| `total_chunks_tombstoned` | `int` | Sum of each source's count, a source named twice counted once (`deleted` repeats it). |

## `knowledge.dataset_approve`

Approve a dataset's schema, retyping the columns named: its rows are typed again from the stored extraction under a new snapshot.

`POST /v1/knowledge.dataset_approve` · MCP `loom_knowledge_dataset_approve` · role `writer` · write · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The ingested source whose dataset is approved. |
| `dataset_id` | `str` | required | The dataset to approve, as knowledge.dataset_get names it. |
| `snapshot_id` | `str` | required | The snapshot the caller reviewed (knowledge.dataset_get); refused once another serves. |
| `columns` | `dict[str, Literal['string', 'number', 'bool', 'date', 'datetime', 'time', 'duration']]` | *(computed)* | Column name to the type it is held as; the columns not named keep theirs. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when the source or the dataset is not live; a later revision, or another approval that retyped the dataset, since the read is 409 PRECONDITION_FAILED (read it again). |
| `dataset` | `DatasetOut \| None` | The dataset as approved; None when not found. |
| `retyped` | `bool` | True when a retyped column made a new snapshot. |

## `knowledge.dataset_get`

The typed datasets an ingested file's tables became: their schemas, what needs a person's answer, the rows rejected and, on request, the first rows.

`POST /v1/knowledge.dataset_get` · MCP `loom_knowledge_dataset_get` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The ingested source whose datasets are read. |
| `dataset_id` | `str` | `''` | One dataset of the source; empty for all of them. |
| `sample_rows` | `int` | `0` | Rows to return of each dataset, from its first (of the first 20 datasets). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when the source has no live document; `datasets` is then empty. |
| `revision` | `int` | The live document's revision. |
| `datasets` | `list[DatasetOut]` | The live revision's datasets, in the order of the file's tables. |

## `knowledge.dedup_list`

List cross-URI doc duplicates and (optionally) chunk-overlap clusters.

`POST /v1/knowledge.dedup_list` · MCP `loom_knowledge_dedup_list` · role `admin` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `limit` | `int` | `50` | At most this many clusters of each kind (1-200). |
| `include_chunk_clusters` | `bool` | `False` | Also return chunk-level clusters (identical chunks under different URIs). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `doc_clusters` | `list[_KnowledgeDocCluster]` | Groups of documents under different URIs whose content hash is identical. |
| `chunk_clusters` | `list[_KnowledgeChunkCluster]` | Groups of identical chunks across URIs; empty unless `include_chunk_clusters`. |

## `knowledge.dedup_resolve`

Resolve one document duplicate pair.

`POST /v1/knowledge.dedup_resolve` · MCP `loom_knowledge_dedup_resolve` · role `admin` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `canonical_uri` | `str` | required | The document of the pair that `keep_canonical` keeps. |
| `duplicate_uri` | `str` | required | The document of the pair that `keep_canonical` supersedes. |
| `decision` | `Literal['keep_canonical', 'swap']` | required | `keep_canonical` supersedes `duplicate_uri`; `swap` supersedes `canonical_uri`. |
| `confirm_duplicate_uri` | `str` | required | Must equal `duplicate_uri`, or the call fails with 400 and nothing changes. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `canonical_uri` | `str` | Echo of the input `canonical_uri`. |
| `duplicate_uri` | `str` | Echo of the input `duplicate_uri`. |
| `decision` | `str` | Echo of the input `decision`. |
| `superseded_uri` | `str` | The URI that was soft-superseded. |

## `knowledge.delete`

Soft-delete a document by source_uri: writes its tombstone.

`POST /v1/knowledge.delete` · MCP `loom_knowledge_delete` · role `writer` · idempotent · audited

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The document to soft-delete. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deleted` | `bool` | True when a live document was tombstoned, or leftover chunks of a deleted or never committed source were retired. |
| `chunks_tombstoned` | `int` | The chunks the delete retired; 0 when it had none, or when a deleted source was restored or written again before the delete took its claim. |

The document formats this deployment reads, as `knowledge.ingest` sends them to its extractors, and the upload's limits.

`POST /v1/knowledge.formats` · MCP `loom_knowledge_formats` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `formats` | `list[KnowledgeFormat]` | Every format the server routes, sorted by name. |
| `max_upload_bytes` | `int` | The largest file POST /v1/knowledge.upload stores, in bytes. |

## `knowledge.get`

Fetch a single document by source_uri.

`POST /v1/knowledge.get` · MCP `loom_knowledge_get` · role `viewer` · read

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The document to fetch. |
| `include_superseded` | `bool` | `False` | Also return a soft-deleted or superseded version; False returns only the live one. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when no document matched; every other field except `source_uri` is then None. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | The document's identifier (the input `source_uri` when not found). |
| `title` | `str \| None` | Document title. |
| `content` | `str \| None` | The document's full extracted text. |
| `tags` | `list[str] \| None` | The document's tags. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | The document's metadata JSON; `{}` when it was empty or unreadable. |
| `ingested_at` | `datetime \| None` | When this version of the document was written. |
| `superseded` | `bool \| None` | True when the returned version is soft-deleted or superseded. |
| `doc_id` | `str \| None` | Id of the returned document version. |
| `revision` | `int \| None` | The source's revision (1, 2, ... per source_uri); 0 for a document no write numbered. |
| `format` | `str \| None` | For a file Loom extracted (knowledge.ingest): the format it was extracted as. |
| `parser` | `str \| None` | For an extracted file: the extractor's parser and version that read it. |
| `coverage` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | For an extracted file: what was extracted (unit, total, extracted, failed, lost). |

## `knowledge.ingest`

Extract an uploaded file (the extractor service parses it, the server checks what it returns) and publish it as a document revision, asynchronously: the answer names the job, and…

`POST /v1/knowledge.ingest` · MCP `loom_knowledge_ingest` · role `writer` · write · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `upload_id` | `str` | required | The `upload_id` POST /v1/knowledge.upload returned for the file. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The document's stable identifier in the namespace; a later ingest of the same source_uri publishes its next revision. |
| `title` | `str` | `''` | Document title; empty takes the upload's file name. |
| `description` | `str` | `''` | Prepended with the title to each chunk before embedding. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Labels stored on the document and every chunk. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any]` | *(computed)* | Free-form JSON stored with the document and every chunk. |
| `expected_revision` | `int \| None` | `None` | Publish only if the source's live revision is this one (0: no live document); unset publishes over whatever is live. |
| `allow_partial` | `bool` | `False` | Publish an extraction that lost part of the source (coverage incomplete), marked `partial`; off fails it instead. |
| `options` | `KnowledgeIngestOptions` | *(computed)* | Overrides for what the file cannot say about itself. |
| `agent` | `str` | `''` | The agent writing the document; an end-user token's signed agent takes its place. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `''` | The session the document was written in. |
| `source_class` | `str \| None` | `None` | `derived`, `external` or `imported` when the content is not the writer's own. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ingestion_id` | `str` | The job's id; `knowledge.ingest_status` and `knowledge.ingest_cancel` take it. |
| `state` | `str` | `pending` until a worker takes it. |
| `source_uri` | `str` |  |
| `namespace` | `str` | The namespace the op reads or writes. |

## `knowledge.ingest_cancel`

A pending job is cancelled at once; a running one stops before it publishes; a finished one stays as it ended.

`POST /v1/knowledge.ingest_cancel` · MCP `loom_knowledge_ingest_cancel` · role `writer` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `ingestion_id` | `str` | required | The `ingestion_id` knowledge.ingest returned. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when no job of this id is in the namespace. |
| `state` | `str` | The job's state after the call: `cancelled` for a job that had not started, its running state when the worker will stop it before publishing, or where it already ended (a published revision stays published). |
| `cancelled` | `bool` | True when this call stopped the job, or asked the worker to. |

## `knowledge.ingest_status`

A knowledge.ingest job's state, stage, coverage, failure and published revision.

`POST /v1/knowledge.ingest_status` · MCP `loom_knowledge_ingest_status` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `ingestion_id` | `str` | required | The `ingestion_id` knowledge.ingest returned. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when no job of this id is in the namespace; every other field is then empty. |
| `ingestion_id` | `str` | The job asked about. |
| `source_uri` | `str` |  |
| `state` | `str` | pending, processing, ready, partial, failed or cancelled. |
| `stage` | `str` | Where a processing job is, or where it last ran: parse, embed or publish; empty once it published. |
| `attempts` | `int` | Runs of the job so far, a retry after a transient failure included. |
| `error_code` | `str` | Why it failed (`format_unavailable`, `encoding`, `incomplete_extraction`, `revision_conflict`, `too_large`, `no_text`, `retries_exhausted`, ...), or `retrying` while it waits for its next attempt; empty otherwise. |
| `error_message` | `str` | The failure in words, for a person; empty when it did not fail. |
| `format` | `str` | The format the file was extracted as, empty before extraction. |
| `coverage` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | What the extraction covered (unit, total, extracted, failed, lost). |
| `warnings` | `list[str]` | The extractor's warnings about the file. |
| `chunks` | `int` | Chunks published, 0 until the job publishes. |
| `revision` | `int` | The revision the job published, 0 until it does. |
| `expected_revision` | `int \| None` | The revision the job requires to be live when it publishes; None for any. |
| `filename` | `str` | The uploaded file's name. |
| `retrieval` | `str` | Whether the document is searchable from this job: ready (published), pending (not yet), failed (it will not be) or cancelled. |
| `cancel_requested` | `bool` | Whether knowledge.ingest_cancel was called for the job. |
| `created_at` | `datetime \| None` |  |
| `updated_at` | `datetime \| None` |  |

## `knowledge.inspect`

Report a namespace's documents, read-only.

`POST /v1/knowledge.inspect` · MCP `loom_knowledge_inspect` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `sample_limit` | `int` | `20` | Newest live documents listed with their chunks and decisions, and the most sample URIs per finding, 0 to 100 (default 20). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `computed_at` | `datetime` | When the report started (UTC). |
| `documents` | `DocumentTotals` | Live and deleted documents by format and source scheme, and retired versions. |
| `chunks` | `ChunkTotals` | Live chunks by embedding model, and how many knowledge.search can return. |
| `decisions` | `DecisionTotals` | Decision rows citing a document of the namespace, by stage. |
| `listed` | `list[InspectDocument]` | The newest live documents, at most `sample_limit`, newest first. |
| `listed_complete` | `bool` | True when `listed` holds every live document and the count was read, and, under the Postgres authority, every document commit of the namespace was published and the listed rows were checked against it. |
| `findings` | `list[DocumentFinding]` | One per check that ran over the documents and chunks; a clean check is an `info` finding with count 0. |
| `coverage` | `ReportCoverage` | Which document checks ran and which were skipped. |
| `ingestions` | `IngestionTotals` | knowledge.ingest jobs by state, and the sources with a job and no live document (a first ingest, or one after a delete, queued or failed). |
| `extraction` | `ExtractionTotals` | What the extractor kept of the live ingested documents. |
| `ingest_findings` | `list[IngestFinding]` | One per ingestion and extraction check that ran: a backlog, an extractor unavailable, missing access, content the extractor rejected, jobs that failed on the server's side, extractions that lost structure. |
| `memory_findings` | `list[MemoryFindingRef]` | namespace.audit's `oversized_values` and `episodic_blobs`, the memory rows that may belong in documents; mentor.brief reports the same shape per agent as `documents_as_memories`. |
| `skipped` | `list[str]` | Sections not read, as "section: reason"; their fields are null or empty, not zero. |

## `knowledge.list`

Paginated listing of documents in a namespace, for curation tools.

`POST /v1/knowledge.list` · MCP `loom_knowledge_list` · role `viewer` · read

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Documents carrying any one of these tags, in any case. |
| `tags_every` | `bool` | `False` | Require every one of `tags` instead of any one; default off. |
| `uri_prefix` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Directory scope: documents whose source_uri starts with one of these prefixes; empty = whole namespace. |
| `include_superseded` | `bool` | `False` | Also list soft-deleted and superseded documents (their `superseded` is True). |
| `limit` | `int` | `50` | At most this many rows per page (1-500); `next_cursor` fetches the next page. |
| `cursor` | `str \| None` | `None` | opaque keyset cursor |
| `fields` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | The output fields the caller reads (a whitelist resolved against the row model, as memory.list's is); unset, every field. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | `list[_KnowledgeListEntry]` | Documents, newest `ingested_at` first. |
| `next_cursor` | `str \| None` | Pass as `cursor` for the next page; None when this is the last page. |

## `knowledge.outline`

A document's table of contents, as recorded on its chunks at ingest, and optionally one section's assembled text.

`POST /v1/knowledge.outline` · MCP `loom_knowledge_outline` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The document to outline. |
| `section_path` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Heading breadcrumb of the section to return as `section_content`; empty returns the outline only. |
| `include_children` | `bool` | `True` | When True, `section_content` also includes the section's subsections. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `found` | `bool` | False when no live document has this `source_uri`; the rest is then empty. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | Echo of the input `source_uri`. |
| `title` | `str` | Document title. |
| `structured` | `bool` | True when the chunks carry section headings; False means `sections` is empty. |
| `chunk_count` | `int` | How many chunks the document has for the current embedding model. |
| `sections` | `list[_OutlineEntry]` | The table of contents in document order: each heading's path, depth, chunks and size. |
| `section_content` | `str \| None` | When `section_path` was given: the section's text (its chunks in order) and the chunk indices it came from. |
| `section_chunk_idxs` | `list[int]` | Chunk indices `section_content` was assembled from; empty when none matched. |

## `knowledge.query`

Calculate over the live snapshots of ingested datasets with a typed plan: filters, inner joins, groups and aggregates, or the rows themselves.

`POST /v1/knowledge.query` · MCP `loom_knowledge_query` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `datasets` | `list[QueryDataset]` | required | The datasets the plan reads, each under its alias. |
| `where` | `list[QueryFilter]` | *(computed)* | The conditions every row read must meet, applied in each dataset before any join. |
| `joins` | `list[QueryJoin]` | *(computed)* | How the datasets past the first join one already in the plan: one join each. |
| `group_by` | `list[QueryGroup]` | *(computed)* | The columns the aggregates are calculated per; empty for one result row. |
| `aggregates` | `list[QueryAggregate]` | *(computed)* | The calculations; empty to return the rows themselves (`select`). |
| `select` | `list[QueryColumn]` | *(computed)* | The columns of each row returned when the plan has no aggregates; each is named `<alias>.<column>` in the result when the plan reads several datasets. |
| `order_by` | `list[QueryOrder]` | *(computed)* | The result's order, by result column names; groups, or rows in source order, by default. |
| `limit` | `int` | `100` | The result rows returned at most; `truncated` says when more matched. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `list[QueryResultColumn]` | The result's columns, in order. |
| `rows` | `list[list[Any]]` | The result's rows; a decimal or an integer JSON cannot hold exactly is its text. |
| `row_ids` | `list[list[int]]` | With no aggregates, each returned row's row id in each dataset, in the plan's dataset order. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | True when more rows matched than `limit` returned. |
| `complete` | `bool` | False when a dataset read is incomplete or rejected rows: the result may not cover the source. |
| `incomplete` | `list[str]` | Why the result is not complete, one reason per dataset. |
| `receipt` | `QueryReceipt` | What was read and how. |

Undo a `knowledge.delete` or `knowledge.bulk_delete` of one document.

`POST /v1/knowledge.restore` · MCP `loom_knowledge_restore` · role `writer` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |

| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The deleted document to restore. |
| `if_revision` | `int \| None` | `None` | Precondition: restore only when the deleted document is at this revision (from `knowledge.get` with `include_superseded=true`); None restores whatever was deleted. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `restored` | `bool` | True when the document and its chunks were made live again. |
| `reason` | `Literal['', 'not_found', 'live', 'revision_mismatch', 'not_restorable', 'expired']` | Why nothing was restored, "" when it was (the reasons: docs/features/knowledge.md). |
| `doc_id` | `str` | The id of the document the answer is about: the restored one, the live one, or the deleted one left retired. |
| `revision` | `int \| None` | That document's revision; None when no document was found. |
| `chunks_restored` | `int` | Chunks searchable again after the restore. |

## `knowledge.search`

Search the user's uploaded document library — bills, contracts, receipts, resumes, policies, manuals, technical docs.

`POST /v1/knowledge.search` · MCP `loom_knowledge_search` · role `viewer` · read · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `query` | `str` | required | Natural-language query; it is embedded for the vector leg and tokenized for BM25. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Keep only chunks carrying at least one of these tags; empty = no tag filter. |
| `since_seconds` | `int \| None` | `None` | optional recency filter |
| `top_k` | `int` | `5` | At most this many hits are returned (1-100). |
| `namespace_scope` | `Literal['this', 'all_mine']` | `'all_mine'` | "this" → input.namespace only; "all_mine" → also the caller's own namespaces, up to `knowledge_search_max_namespaces`. |
| `namespaces` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Search `namespace` and exactly these (an agent's collection, `@me`) instead of a fan-out; each must be one the caller may read, else the call is refused (403). |
| `search_mode` | `Literal['hybrid', 'semantic', 'lexical']` | `'hybrid'` | hybrid: the vector leg, the BM25 lexical leg and the exact-key leg (the query's identifiers looked up in an extracted file's chunk keys) fused by reciprocal rank; semantic: vector only; lexical: BM25 only. |
| `lexical_weight` | `float` | `1.0` | Weight of the lexical leg in reciprocal-rank fusion (hybrid mode). 1.0 = equal weight; lower it for queries whose tokens are ubiquitous in the corpus (paths, boilerplate) where the lexical leg cannot discriminate. |
| `narrow_spans` | `bool` | `False` | Needle reads: also return, per hit, the two-sentence window of the chunk nearest the query as `span`, so a caller after one fact reads a sentence instead of a 1,500-character section. |
| `collapse_sections` | `bool` | `True` | Keep one hit per (document, section): the best-ranked chunk represents its section and reports how many siblings it folded. |
| `uri_prefix` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Directory scope: only chunks whose source_uri starts with one of these prefixes. |
| `session_ids` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Only chunks of documents written in one of these sessions (a chat's own attachments, an agent run's output). |
| `source_classes` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Only chunks of these classes, e.g. ["asserted"] for what people and their agents wrote as their own, without what an agent derived or fetched. |
| `formats` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Only chunks of documents in these formats: an ingested file's `format` (`sql`, `toml`, `markdown`, ...), or '' for every other document, a synced one included whatever `knowledge.inspect` names it (`knowledge.get` returns null for those). |
| `block_types` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Only chunks of these block types (`sql_statement`, `toml_table`, `toml_key`, `heading`, `paragraph`, `code`, `mixed`, ...). |
| `rerank` | `str` | `''` | Reranker for the fused head: "" = the deployment default (LOOM_KNOWLEDGE_SEARCH_RERANK_DEFAULT), "none" = off, "builtin:openai[:<model>]", "builtin:cohere[:<model>]" or an endpoint name in LOOM_RERANK_ENDPOINTS_JSON (no URL). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `results` | `list[_SearchHit]` | Hits best first (empty when nothing matched): when `reranked_by` is set, the reranked head in the reranker's order, then the rest by `score`; else by `score` (then similarity). |
| `reranked_by` | `str` | The reranker that ordered `results`; empty when no reranker ran, it failed, it ran past its time limit, or it kept the fused order. |
| `embedding_model` | `str` | Embedding model the query was embedded with; only chunks of this model are searched. |
| `namespaces_skipped` | `list[str]` | Namespaces of the caller an all_mine search did not read because it stops at `memory_search_fanout_max_namespaces`; address one by name to search it. |

## `knowledge.source.add`

Register a document source on a repository's trunk code namespace: a kind, the ids it reads and a read-only credential.

`POST /v1/knowledge.source.add` · MCP `loom_knowledge_source_add` · role `admin` · write · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The org. |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The repository's trunk code namespace. |
| `name` | `str` | required | Source name: 2-32 lower-case letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter; trimmed and lower-cased. |
| `kind` | `str` | required | The source kind: `gdrive` (a shared folder), `linear` (a project tracker's project documents), `notion` (a page store's pages and databases) or `recording` (a meeting store's transcripts). |
| `config` | `dict[str, Any]` | required | The ids and filters the source reads, per kind; gdrive: {folder_ids: [1-20 folder ids], include: [docs, slides, pdf, pptx, docx] (default all but docx)}; linear: {project_ids: [1-20 project ids, UUIDs]}; notion: {page_ids: [...]… |
| `credential` | `str` | required | The source's read-only credential (gdrive: a service account's JSON key, with the folders shared to the account read-only; linear: a read-only API key of an account that sees the projects; notion: an integration token with read content… |
| `dry_run` | `bool` | `False` | Probe and write nothing. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `str` | The registered source's name, normalised. |
| `kind` | `str` | The source kind, normalised. |
| `namespace` | `str` | The repository's trunk code namespace the source was registered on. |
| `config` | `dict[str, Any]` | The config as stored. |
| `probe` | `KnowledgeSourceProbe` | What the probe with the credential found. |
| `dry_run` | `bool` | True when the call only probed. |

## `knowledge.synthesize`

Complete a task over WHOLE documents, not a search slice: every active chunk of the named documents is read in order, in windows that respect section boundaries, each window is noted once, and the…

`POST /v1/knowledge.synthesize` · MCP `loom_knowledge_synthesize` · role `viewer` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uris` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | The documents to read in full (up to 50; this, `datasets` or both); unknown URIs contribute nothing. |
| `datasets` | `list[QueryDataset]` | *(computed)* | Datasets to calculate over (up to 4, as knowledge.query takes them); one plan is proposed for the task, checked against their schemas and run over every row. |
| `task` | `str` | required | What to do with the documents and datasets: a question to answer or a summary to write. |
| `window_chars` | `int` | `24000` | Characters of document text per map call; the reduce folds notes into batches of the same size, and a calculation's note is at most half of it. |
| `max_answer_chars` | `int` | `8000` | Cap on the answer's length in characters; a longer answer is cut and ends with `…`. |
| `max_windows` | `int` | `64` | Cap on map calls; a corpus needing more is answered from the first `max_windows` windows and `truncated` is set. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `answer` | `str` | The task's answer, citing chunks as `[source#idx]` and the calculation as `[knowledge.query#1]`; empty when it abstained. |
| `windows` | `int` | How many windows were read (one LLM map call each). |
| `chunks_read` | `int` | How many chunks the read windows covered. |
| `documents` | `int` | How many of the named documents had chunks to read. |
| `reduce_rounds` | `int` | How many fold rounds merged the notes into the answer; 1 when they fit one call. |
| `citations` | `list[str]` | Distinct `source#idx` (or `source#a-b`, or a list of them for a window spanning documents) citations in the answer, and `knowledge.query#1`, in the order found; each names chunks the passes read or the calculation run. |
| `cited_chunks` | `list[_CitedChunk]` | Each chunk the kept `citations` name, once, in the order first cited: its revision and its locator, so a caller can open the passage the answer came from. |
| `unsupported_citations` | `list[str]` | Citations the model wrote naming a chunk the passes did not read, or a calculation not run; removed from `answer`. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | True when the documents needed more than `max_windows` windows and only the first were read. |
| `abstain` | `bool` | True when there is no answer to give; `abstain_reason` says why. |
| `abstain_reason` | `str` | Why it abstained: `budget_capped` (over the cost cap), `no_chunks` (nothing to read), `needs_clarification`, `ambiguous`, `invalid_plan` (see `clarification`) or `empty_answer`. |
| `clarification` | `str` | ambiguous: the question to ask; invalid_plan: why no plan held; needs_clarification: the dataset to approve (knowledge.dataset_approve); empty otherwise. |
| `calculations` | `list[SynthesizeCalculation]` | The calculation run over the datasets, cited in `answer` as `[knowledge.query#1]`. |
| `model` | `str` | LLM that wrote the notes and the answer; empty when it abstained before any call. |

## `knowledge.update_metadata`

Edit doc-level metadata (title, description, tags).

`POST /v1/knowledge.update_metadata` · MCP `loom_knowledge_update_metadata` · role `writer` · idempotent · audited · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The live document to edit; an unknown or deleted one is a 404. |
| `title` | `str \| None` | `None` | None means "leave unchanged" (sparse update); empty string is an explicit clear. |
| `description` | `str \| None` | `None` | New description; None leaves it unchanged, empty string clears it. |
| `tags` | `list[str] \| None` | `None` | New tag list, replacing the old one; None leaves it unchanged, `[]` clears it. |
| `reindex` | `bool` | `False` | When True, rewrite every chunk with the new title + description in its context (re-embedded, re-scored by the lexical leg), routed through the upsert flow for identical supersession semantics (same content, fresh chunks). |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `updated` | `bool` | True when the title, description or tags changed; a reindex's rewrite shows in chunks_reindexed. |
| `title` | `str` | Echo the post-update state so the client doesn't need to refetch. |
| `description` | `str` | The document's description after the call. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | The document's tags after the call. |
| `chunks_reindexed` | `int` | Count of chunks re-embedded when reindex=True; 0 otherwise. |

## `knowledge.upsert`

Same fields as knowledge.add.

`POST /v1/knowledge.upsert` · MCP `loom_knowledge_upsert` · role `writer` · idempotent · not listed under the MCP `all` toolset

| Input field | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `org` | `str` | required | The tenant (first element of the identity tuple). |
| `namespace` | `str` | required | The namespace the op reads or writes. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | required | The document's stable identifier in the namespace; `get`, `upsert` and `delete` name it. |
| `content` | `str` | required | The document's extracted text; it is split into chunks, and each chunk is embedded. |
| `title` | `str` | `''` | Document title, stored on the document and in each chunk's context, which heads the chunk's embedded text and is scored by the lexical leg. |
| `description` | `str` | `''` | Stored (with the title) in each chunk's context, so both search legs carry doc-level context. |
| `tags` | `list[str]` | *(computed)* | Labels stored on the document and on every chunk; search and list filter on them. |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any]` | *(computed)* | Free-form JSON stored with the document and on every chunk; `knowledge.get` returns it. |
| `original_bytes_b64` | `str \| None` | `None` | Original file bytes (base64), preserved alongside extracted text so users can download exactly what they uploaded. |
| `original_filename` | `str` | `''` | Name of the uploaded file; empty keeps the prior document's name when its blob carries over. |
| `blob_content_type` | `str` | `''` | Media type of `original_bytes_b64`; empty keeps the prior blob's type when it carries over. |
| `agent` | `str` | `''` | The agent writing the document, stored on it and on every chunk for provenance; an end-user token's signed `agent` takes its place. |
| `session_id` | `str` | `''` | The session the document was written in (a chat, an agent run): stored on it and on every chunk, and `knowledge.search` filters on it. |
| `source_class` | `str \| None` | `None` | What the content is, when it is not the writer's own: `derived` (an agent wrote it from other content), `external` (fetched: a page, a tool's result) or `imported`. |

| Output field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `doc_id` | `str` | Id of the document version this call wrote (a fresh UUID per write). |
| `chunks_created` | `int` | How many chunks the new content was split into and embedded. |
| `chunks_superseded` | `int` | How many live chunks of the prior version were superseded; 0 on a first write. |
| `embedding_model` | `str` | Embedding model that produced the chunk vectors. |
| `embedding_dim` | `int` | Dimension of the chunk vectors. |
| `duplicate_of_uri` | `str` | Content-hash dedup surfacing: warn-not-block — the upsert succeeds either way; the caller decides whether to reuse the existing doc. |
| `duplicate_chunk_count` | `int` | New chunks whose content hash already lives under a different `source_uri`. |
| `namespace` | `str` | Echo the JWT-bound namespace so agents cite it instead of guessing. |
| `source_uri` | `str` | Echo of the input `source_uri`. |
